requiredConfiguration.OPENAI_MODEL: Optional model name; default gpt-4o-mini; must match endpoint support.
requiredConfiguration.HARNESS_DATA_DIR: Optional; set for persistent sessions/events/approval/checkpoint; absence is in-memory.
